:::{#exm-not-question}
#### Overlapping answers do not form a question
<!-- no-figure: the example lists two sets, with nothing to plot -->

Let $X$ be as in @exm-question.
The two sets $\{0, 1, \ldots, 40\}$ and $\{32, 33, \ldots, 63\}$ cover $\srcalph$,
but both hold the values $32, 33, \ldots, 40$.
They are not disjoint, so they do not form a [question](#def-question):
when $X = 35$, no single possible answer holds the value of $X$.

:::
